manifest.title: Reptile House entrance steps — 2010
manifest.alt: Stone steps between low stone walls lead to an open doorway beneath a Reptile House sign, with trees and shrubs beside the approach.
manifest.caption: A September 2010 photograph shows steps and the doorway at the Reptile House. Full frame retained from the publisher’s 960-pixel version and converted to WebP.

manifest.limitations: Historical photograph. It does not establish the entrance used today, another step-free approach, door controls, dimensions or conditions inside. Ask the zoo about the current Reptile House route before relying on this view.

inspection_batches.result: No confidently matched Falcon frontage. Two tiled-entry views are useful but business/address not established; other views show different blocks/storefronts. Four further downloads failed and remain uninspected.

pdf_visual_review.note: All pages of each social narrative and the welcome poster inspected. Kings Island text reviewed for selected claims; five policy pages also rendered and inspected, not all 68 pages.

held.reason: Official doorway photo credited to Lisa Dirkes; no reuse licence. Full view shows 636 Monmouth and a 2017–2018 season poster, but capture date unknown; raised tiled frontage and doorway do not establish a step-free threshold.
Office portrait, no useful access-route view or reuse licence.
Food-can close-up; no access-route information or reuse licence.

33-page, 28,239,541-byte 2025 seasonal guide; all pages inspected. Arrival 3–7, restrooms 25–26, seating 27, calming room 28. Mixed photographs/illustrations; metadata says containsAiGeneratedContent=Yes without identifying which elements. Not linked as photographic evidence or used for current policy. Size exceeds the helper limit; no failed-gate bypass attempted.

One-page poster has July 2018 metadata and predicts early-2019 facilities. Portrait rather than facility walkthrough; old skip-the-line wording must not replace current equal-wait Access Pass description.
CC0 July 2026 source and original Flickr checked; view cuts off queue/ground and shows mainly roof/sign.
Current paving view but distant visitors and little distinct access detail; held in favour of more specific queue and sensory views.
2023 test-seat/entry view has a prominent identifiable person; no platform lift or transfer route visible.

January 4, 2024 post: four images inspected. One shows the Claire Fitton Dance Studio door beside glazed entry doors with an overhead mechanism, but the threshold is out of view. Two posed portraits and a sign close-up provide little route evidence. No reuse licence found.

September 6, 2024 post: three images inspected, including an event-poster composite. The Trilogy image shows East Plaza paving and broad stairs with handrails; no alternative level-to-level route is visible. The Complexity view shows planting beside the building, not doorway clearance. No reuse licence found.
February 2022 event report describes street-level lobby and basement shop; current routes remain unverified.
